subject.title: feat(plugins): add exact-profile provider usage reads

question: Should OpenClaw publish `api.runtime.providerUsage.read` as a permanent plugin SDK contract for per-auth-profile quota reads, including its fail-closed and redaction semantics?
rationale: The patch adds a new public runtime namespace and exported types across provider auth and plugin boundaries; tests can validate mechanics but cannot determine whether this is the intended supported plugin capability.

options.title: Hold for SDK contract approval
options.body: Do not merge the public API until a plugin SDK owner explicitly approves its supported consumers, redaction guarantees, alias behavior, and compatibility commitment.

options.title: Approve the exact-profile API
options.body: Accept this as a supported plugin capability, then require redacted live-provider proof and focused contract coverage before merge.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Remove the exported plugin runtime seam and retain only internal implementation work until an approved consumer establishes the required public contract.

recommendation.title: Hold for SDK contract approval
recommendation.body: Do not merge the public API until a plugin SDK owner explicitly approves its supported consumers, redaction guarantees, alias behavior, and compatibility commitment.

likelyOwner.reason: No individual current-main owner could be established safely from the supplied review context; the decision belongs with the people responsible for the plugin SDK contract.
